title: Fixed Horizontal Four-Cradle Reading Wheel
description: One newly authored whole static reading-wheel furniture appearance for a fantasy study. Two continuous open triangular side stands on full long runners carry one complete horizontal shaft and two large open spoke-and-rim carriers. Four complete inclined reading boards, each with an integral raised front retaining lip, are individually suspended from the paired rims by short side straps and short pivots. All boards retain the same fixed reading attitude while occupying distinct upper/front/back/lower positions; no shaft crosses their reading surfaces. Two full low ties connect the stand runners, and the boards, rims and centre shaft remain raised clear of one another in this stored pose.
